jobs.title: Lead Product Designer, Arc Platform
jobs.why: Circle is a well-funded fintech platform and Lead Product Designer in LA aligns with Garman's Storyfire, Xome, and Toyota Garage product design work. Strongest proof points are end-to-end platform ownership and fintech adjacency via Mr. Cooper. Risk: 'Lead' title is a step-down from ACD and crypto-specific knowledge gap.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer, Arc Platform
jobs.why: Lead Product Designer at Circle (Arc crypto/payments platform) — Tier 3 candidate given Garman's strong platform UX portfolio. Strong overlap with Storyfire (solo platform lead) and Mr. Cooper (fintech UX), but crypto domain is non-core and no salary listed. Title is below ACD level.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.why: Director of Product Design title fits Garman's level. Hiive is a private-market securities marketplace; Garman's Xome (real estate marketplace) and Mr. Cooper (fintech) provide relevant proof. Risk: early-stage startup in Seattle, Garman's creative-director framing may need repositioning as product-first.

jobs.title: Executive Creative Director
jobs.why: ECD at a major CPG brand is a reach from Garman's ACD level. Brand systems thinking and AI pipeline are relevant differentiators, but CPG domain is thin (only Jeffry's at small scale) and Chicago relocation would be required.

jobs.title: Art Director, E-Commerce
jobs.why: Art Director is two levels below Garman's current ACD role; NY location is another barrier. Some e-commerce/retail creative overlap (Taco Bell, Adidas Golf digital) but the role level and domain fit are both weak relative to Garman's profile.

jobs.title: Design Operations Lead
jobs.why: Design Operations is a process/infrastructure role that does not leverage Garman's creative direction, art direction, or brand-systems strengths. Chime is a notable fintech brand but the role is misaligned with Garman's profile.

jobs.title: Head of Performance Creative (Pet Brand)
jobs.why: Pay range is strong ($200-250K) but 'Performance Creative' is performance-marketing oriented (paid media, direct response, A/B testing creative) rather than brand systems or product design direction. Pet brand domain and pure DTC performance focus do not align with Garman's strengths.

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Art
jobs.why: ACD Art title matches Garman's level and the pay range is just above his $140K baseline. Agency environment aligns with his background. Risk: NJ location is not LA or remote; Princeton10 is a smaller unknown agency; pay at baseline with NJ cost of living is not a clear step up for Garman.

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Ring Retail & Marketing
jobs.why: ACD-level role at Amazon Ring in Hawthorne, CA (LA area) with pay up to $190K — a meaningful step up from current $140K. Ring retail & marketing creative direction maps directly to Garman's Toyota/Lexus retail CRM and integrated brand campaigns at Rapp. Risk: large Amazon org structure can be process-heavy; Ring is a subsidiary rather than a flagship Amazon brand team.

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Ring Retail & Marketing
jobs.why: ACD title is an exact match. Amazon Ring is a consumer tech device brand, and Garman's Apple/iAd history plus Toyota launch campaign depth prove strong tech brand credibility. Pay range ($141-190.7K) is a genuine step up. Risk: posted February 28, 2026 — role is 3.5 months old and may already be filled or in late-stage hiring.
